# semrel-plugins — Official 46 Plugin Catalog for semrel

[![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-www.semrel.io-6366f1)](https://www.semrel.io/plugins/)
[![Plugin Registry](https://img.shields.io/badge/registry-registry.semrel.io-10b981)](https://registry.semrel.io)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Community%20(Release%20Ping)-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/w8zTm2r3jg)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/SemRels/semrel/blob/main/LICENSE)

Official first-party plugin catalog for [**semrel**](https://github.com/SemRels/semrel) — the zero-dependency, Go-native semantic release automation tool and open-source alternative to `semantic-release`, `GoReleaser`, and `release-please`.

Every official plugin ships as a **Sigstore Cosign-signed static binary** and container image, pinned by SHA-256 checksum in `.semrel.lock` for reproducible, air-gap safe CI/CD pipelines.

```bash
# Install any official plugin
semrel plugin install @semrel/provider-github

# Restore all pinned plugins in CI without outbound internet access
semrel plugin restore
```

## Plugin Contract

See the [Plugin Development Guide](https://www.semrel.io/guide/plugin-development/) for a step-by-step tutorial on writing custom plugins.

All plugins communicate via:

- **Environment variables** → plugin: release context (`SEMREL_*`) and plugin config (`SEMREL_PLUGIN_*`)
- **stdout** (analyzers only): JSON analysis result
- **stderr**: logs and `plugin_schema_version=N` announcement
- **Exit code**: 0 = success, non-zero = abort release
